task.summary: Write, save, reopen, and verify a Windows batch health check in Notepad

summary.release_gate: accuracy passing; v24 remains the sub-300-second speed candidate, while v28 fixed Save-filename localization live and retained exact current bytes but timed out after the Open verifier discarded a safe prepared filename followup

attempts.reason: The VNC adapter timed out during visible workspace preflight before a managed run or any task input existed. The campaign reboot call also timed out.
The model reached 35 completed actions but exceeded the 900-second managed-run limit while repeatedly entering and verifying the program line by line.
The first batched Notepad draft was issued once, but its readback remained unverified. The unverified-draft guard blocked every proposed follow-up that could change or execute the ambiguous draft.
Atomic shifted-character transport removed one delivery fault, but exact multiline proof still selected the wrong screen region and the unverified-draft guard stopped the run.
The multiline verifier preserved the input but the controller repeated an unchanged paused action. The campaign stopped after the identical error repeated twice.
The compact line-break commit was classified outside the bounded local-edit allowlist. The campaign refused to auto-approve it and stopped fail-closed.
Titleless Windows Notepad was still not independently grounded strongly enough for the batched line-break action, so the campaign stopped at a non-allowlisted approval before entering the program.

Pixel-grounded titleless Notepad allowed all nine code rows to be delivered in one deferred-exact batch, but the later full-path Save/Open field readback loop remained unverified and was blocked before commit.

The full-frame OCR pass missed an obviously visible blank Notepad window and the titleless-surface gate refused the code batch. A bounded window crop recovered the exact title, menu, character count, newline mode, and encoding after the run.

The bounded Notepad OCR retry enabled the deferred nine-row batch, and basename-only native dialogs eventually saved and reopened the file. The installed observer then read the nested artifact through guarded MCP and returned bytes that exactly matched the later program-entry tool call after Windows CRLF normalization. The model populated two separate Notepad documents and wandered through repeated save/open checks, so this is an accuracy pass and a severe speed failure.

The run delivered the nine program rows once, then repeated the Save As filename loop four times. Exact `code-08.cmd` delivery was acknowledged once per attempt, but the verifier moved focus with Tab and read the adjacent `Text documents (*.txt)` control as the filename. The run was aborted after the fourth measured repetition instead of waiting for the 900-second limit.

The isolated VNC adapter lost its framebuffer during the first Notepad-launch action and returned HTTP 500. No content action completed. After endpoint recovery, the retained campaign completed its mandatory reboot without replaying content.

The caret-only filename remediation recovered from one autocomplete-biased readback and later verified the exact basename. The saved program retained the requested ping/errorlevel branch semantics, but the observer found byte zero changed from @ to a double quote. Event receipts prove the model requested @echo off and request/emission/delivery hashes matched; the restored adapter was incorrectly running an en-us keymap against the UK guest. The verifier then falsely called the correct branches reversed, attempted an unnecessary rewrite, and the next action was interrupted. This run is retained but excluded from accuracy statistics.

The corrected UK-keymap lab passed preflight and began a standard allowlisted Notepad launch. Exact OCR of the seven-character Run field consumed the entire 120-second computer-call deadline, returned transport-uncertain, retried once, and then returned interrupted after another 38.506 seconds. No program content was entered. The failure isolated 88.3% of managed time to action execution rather than model latency.
attempts.observer_comparison: not applicable; no task artifact content was entered

attempts.reason: The narrow safe-launch remediation reduced the first Notepad action from 158.625 seconds to 22.028 seconds and all 15 HID actions completed. The installed observer then returned 117 bytes that exactly matched the cumulative input sequence, but the immutable plan required only 115 bytes: a continuation action appended a duplicate terminal CRLF after the grouped burst had already emitted it. The public receipt boundary also dropped deferred provenance, causing 15 deterministic completion rejections and 14 no-progress resumptions. The final replan erased artifact_content and bypassed that gate, so the campaign's public pass is retained as a false positive while the accepted result fails byte-exact accuracy.

The managed run correctly stopped before committing an unknown-risk click, but it did not begin from a valid clean task surface. The 276-character raw-HID workspace preflight silently failed while reporting a preservation intent as ready: two observer captures found the old 117-byte v15 artifact at the live path, while two further captures found no file at the claimed preservation path. The visible observer from the preceding acceptance check also remained on screen. No task input committed, so v16 is retained as infrastructure-invalid rather than counted as a model accuracy result.

The managed model run was exact and substantially faster: all 12 actions completed, two observer captures returned 127 bytes matching both the immutable plan and cumulative editor input, and there were no completion rejections or autonomous resumptions. The setup gate still failed independent verification, however. A checksum-valid observer capture returned open failed for the claimed preserved-old-artifact path. Because preservation was reported but not achieved, v17 is retained as infrastructure-invalid rather than replacing the canonical accepted attempt.

The shorter, unchained ren preflight still silently failed. Two checksum-valid observer captures found the exact 127-byte v17 artifact at the original path, while a separate checksum-valid capture returned open failed for the new claimed preservation path. The model entered its 119-byte planned draft in an unsaved Notepad buffer and reached the existing-file confirmation. Policy classified the proposed Yes click as unknown risk, refused it, and committed no overwrite. Because the task did not begin from a fresh surface, v18 is retained as infrastructure-invalid rather than counted as a model accuracy result.

The self-verifying preflight proved code-08.cmd absent, but ordinary OCR clipped the foreground Notepad status row. Policy therefore treated the nine-row editor batch's Enter keys as unknown-risk and refused the non-allowlisted approval before document input. The installed observer independently returned open failed for the current path.

The taller bounded crop retained the status row, but normal OCR still rendered the tiny foreground menu without its File label. The unchanged independent Notepad gate refused the nine-row Enter batch before document input.
attempts.observer_gap: No installed-observer capture was completed before v21. The next recorded preflight independently returned verified_absent; this is retained as a coverage gap rather than rewritten as observer proof.

attempts.reason: The precise broad-window fallback retained title, status, CRLF and blank-canvas evidence but again omitted only Notepad's File menu label. Policy refused the nine-row Enter batch before document input.
attempts.observer_gap: No installed-observer capture was completed before v22. The next recorded preflight independently returned verified_absent; this is retained as a coverage gap rather than rewritten as observer proof.

attempts.reason: The precise same-frame menu strip completed the title, menu, status and blank-canvas proof, allowing all nine code rows to execute once. The Save As filename receipt then observed a longer prior-suggestion string instead of exact code-08.cmd. One bounded recovery was retained; the unverified-draft guard blocked the controller before Save commit. The installed observer returned open failed for the current path.

The selected native filename edit was localized from the same-row File name label, excluding the open autocomplete history. Its 11-byte basename receipt was exact and emitted once. The managed loop saved, reopened, and completed after two bounded verification recoveries; a four-page checksum-valid installed-observer capture returned exactly the 127 bytes emitted by this run, with zero dangerous commits.

The bounded Open-filename optimization was exercised: one burst focused the verified native filename field, selected it, and typed the exact basename before an exact visual readback. This removed the focus-only verifier and corrective click loop, cutting managed wall time below 300 seconds. The final bare Enter remained unknown risk and was correctly not auto-approved, so the file was not reopened and completion was not claimed.

terminal_unapproved_action.reason: bare Enter/Return may commit the focused surface

attempts.reason: All nine code rows were emitted exactly once, but Save As basename readback included an autocomplete-history suffix and remained unverified_wrong_region. A focus-only recovery visibly found code-08.cmd; it could not overwrite the ambiguous input receipt. The guard rejected both the replacement draft and the later click commit before HID. The current path remained absent, while the installed observer exactly matched the genuinely preserved v24 artifact.

optimization.reason: The run stopped in the earlier Save As filename flow before Open.

attempts.reason: Visible workspace setup displayed the fresh success marker for more than twelve seconds and offline OCR read it cleanly, but the live preflight poll did not accept it before timeout. No model run or task input began. The campaign still completed its mandatory transition-observed reboot.

The retry-hardened workspace preflight succeeded on its first marker attempt and all nine code rows were emitted exactly once. Save As localization again selected autocomplete-history rows instead of the labelled filename edit, so the exact receipt remained unverified_wrong_region and the guard rejected Save before HID. The installed observer independently confirmed the current path remained absent.

The deterministic filename localization and crop-margin remediation was exercised live: Save As returned exact code-08.cmd with zero corrections or retries, Save committed, and the installed observer matched all 127 current-run bytes. The task still exceeded 300 seconds because the Open verifier treated a filtered or non-listed .cmd view as absence, discarded the already-prepared exact-filename followup, and sent the model through cancel and Save As inspection.

remaining_failure.open_verifier_summary: The Open dialog is in the prepared folder, but code-08.cmd is not visibly listed to reopen.

remediations.change: Bound stale VNC capture before reconnect so adapter loss cannot hold an action indefinitely.
Batch exact Notepad artifact entry instead of paying one model/OCR cycle per row.
Negotiate atomic shifted-character transport for punctuation-heavy code.
Verify one multiline editor burst once after delivery.
Ground Notepad line-break batches before allowing Enter.
Recognize titleless Windows Notepad as the bounded editor surface.
Combine titleless Notepad OCR geometry with blank-canvas pixels and skip unnecessary precise OCR on the hot path.
Use the visible workspace breadcrumb and short basename in native Save/Open dialogs instead of repeatedly typing the full path.
Retry blank-Notepad proof once inside the bounded foreground window when full-frame OCR misses it.
Commit Save As with the native Alt+S access key and permit the observer to read two safe nested workspace segments.
Keep short safe filenames focused and move only the caret for OCR, preventing Tab from selecting the adjacent file-type control.
Expose the isolated adapter keymap and refuse a VNC lab connection when it disagrees with the configured layout, preventing US/UK shifted-symbol corruption from reaching a task.
Defer inline OCR only for the existing strict allowlisted Windows Run launch and require the ordinary post-launch visual verifier.
Preserve deferred input provenance, prevent a grouped editor burst from appending its terminal newline twice, and keep the first accepted artifact content immutable across replans.
Show the desktop before and after task setup and segment the silent 276-character workspace command into short basename-only preservation operations.
Remove shifted shell chaining from artifact preservation, use a single bounded ren command, and report its result as requested-unverified until observer proof exists.
Separate rename and existence proof, emit OCR-safe markers without shifted punctuation, and accept preflight readiness only after verified absence or a visible preserved-path marker.
Extend the bounded foreground-Notepad crop far enough to retain the independently grounded status row.
Retry the unchanged blank-Notepad geometry proof with multi-scale precise OCR only after both cheaper reads fail.
Fuse a narrow same-frame menu-strip read with the broad title, status and blank-canvas evidence when dense background tabs hide only the File label.
Ground a safe native filename to the edit row horizontally paired with the File name label, excluding exact-looking autocomplete history from readback localization.
After a verified Open dialog, combine Alt+N, Ctrl+A and exact basename typing into one burst while preserving exact field readback before the separate Open commit.
Preserve the exact Open filename receipt when the verified Alt+N, Ctrl+A, exact-type burst precedes the separate grounded Open commit.
Use labelled secondary OCR evidence to localize the native filename edit while preserving exact readback as the acceptance gate.
Retry the complete workspace-marker challenge once with a fresh nonce when the first visible marker is not accepted, without bypassing the readiness gate.
Prefer the safe filename value paired with the visible File name label, use that label as a bounded same-row fallback when OCR omits the value, and retain enough left glyph margin for exact reread.

The filename field produced an exact visual readback receipt despite the open autocomplete history.
The accepted run and the post-observer cleanup each completed a transition-observed reboot.

v24 current-run and genuinely preserved-prior bytes independently matched their immutable sources, and both required reboots observed transitions.

The v25 current path remained absent, the genuinely preserved v24 artifact matched exactly, zero dangerous commits were observed, and both required reboots observed transitions.
The v25 run did not reach Open, so commit faf687b was not exercised live and v24 remains the latest speed candidate.
v26 retained a visible-marker preflight timeout before any model or task input; its complete fresh-nonce retry shipped in 583d013 and the mandatory reboot observed a transition.

v27 exercised the labelled filename-localization remediation after a one-attempt successful preflight, emitted all 127 editor bytes once, and still failed closed when live OCR selected history at y=370 instead of the labelled row at y=348.
The v27 observer independently confirmed the current file was absent with zero dangerous commits; no preserved-prior artifact was genuinely claimed, and both required reboots observed transitions.
v28 exercised commit 482a60f live: the Save basename verified exact in 19.603 seconds with zero corrections or retries, Save committed, and all eleven attempted actions completed.
The v28 observer exactly matched all 127 current-run bytes with zero dangerous commits; no prior artifact was claimed, and both required reboots observed transitions.

v28 still failed at 296.767 seconds because the Open verifier treated a non-listed .cmd under the visible file view as absence, discarded the prepared exact-filename followup, and initiated a cancel-and-reinspect model loop even though the observer later proved the file existed.
next_gate.next_attempt: Bound Open-dialog verification to the independently visible native dialog and exact workspace breadcrumb, allowing the already-prepared Alt+N, Ctrl+A, exact-basename followup even when the current file filter does not list .cmd files. Preserve the separate exact field readback and grounded Open commit. Run v29 only after a regression proves the filtered-list case, and accept the speed gate only if the complete task passes with exact observer proof and mandatory reboots.
